judgment: There is trust; the heart goes through.
image: Water comes again and again: Pit after pit.
So the noble one holds virtue and conduct constant,
lines: Pit after pit: down into a pit inside the pit.
Seeking, he gets a little of what he seeks.
down into a pit inside the pit.
A jar of wine and two vessels of grain, in plain earthenware —
the simple gift passed in at the window.
The water in the pit is not overfull;
Bound with cords and set down among thorns,
for three years he finds no way out.

notes.name_en: 坎 is a pit, hole, trap in the ground; rejecting Wilhelm's 'The Abysmal'. Revised pilot: 凶 now 'Misfortune.', Image pivot 'So…'.
notes.L3: 險且枕 kept literal — peril as his pillow, resting his head on danger; 入于坎窞 repeats L1 word for word.
notes.L4: 簋 ritual grain vessels; 約 the frugal/simple gift; 牖 a window-opening.
notes.judgment: 維心亨: B links trust and heart in one sentence — 'There is trust; the heart goes through.'
